metric: RGBA in [0,1]: rmse over all channels; changed_fraction = share of pixels whose largest channel difference exceeds 8/255

measured.method: tools/regression/run.py --noise: every character built, exported and rendered twice from the same commit (bpy 5.3.0, Linux x86_64, Cycles CPU, 16 samples, OIDN, seed 0), renders of the two runs compared
measured.engine_export: order-independent summary equal; raw geometry.bin differs (triangle/vertex order, float noise <= 1.1e-6)

rule: threshold = about 2x the largest measured noise (girl front view), rounded up; any render above it is a FAIL for an unchanged character
